There is no inbound attack surface to add."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What it can and cannot do"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Reads** — sessions, trajectories, raw event timelines, subagents, lineage."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Watches** — with `mirror: true`, every turn the harness runs appears in its workspace's channel as"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"

"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"back. **This is off by default** (`allowRun: false`) because it is the one command that causes

`allowedUser"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"Ids` — the guild owner alone when that list is empty. The same rule governs who may run
commands, so"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" what a person can read and what they can ask never diverge."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Privacy is re-applied on **every** sync, not only at creation, so a category that already existed —
"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"or one created before this was turned on — gets locked down rather than left as it is. If the bot

Message Content **off**."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**2 — Invite it** to your server with the `bot` and `applications.commands` scopes:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"That number is *View Channels*, *Send Messages*, *Embed Links*, *Attach Files*, *Manage Channels*,

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **One guild.** Interactions from any other guild are dropped before authorization runs.
- **Allowl"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ist.** An empty `allowedUserIds` authorizes the guild owner only — never the whole
server. Add ids t"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"o widen it deliberately. The same list gates channel visibility.
- **Private channels by default.** "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"`@everyone` is denied; only the bot and the allowlist can read.
- **No privileged intents.** Only `G"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"uilds`. The bot cannot read anyone's messages.
- **Session text is neutralized** before it enters a "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"message: code fences cannot break out and
mentions cannot ping the server.
- **No execution unless y"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ou ask for it.** `allowRun` is off by default; with it off, nothing here
can run a command or drive "},{"id":"p28s8","text":"an agent. With it on, the allowlist is a shell-access list — see the
warning at the top.
- **Approva"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"l is never automatic.** The bot cannot approve on your behalf, and a card that times out
is handed b"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ack to dsh rather than decided.
- **Mirroring is opt-in.** With `mirror` off — the default — nothing"},{"id":"p28s11","text":" reaches a channel unless
someone asks for it. With it on, every session's conversation is continuou"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"sly exported to Discord,
including work started at the machine by someone who never chose that.
- **"},{"id":"p28s13","text":"`/dsh cmd`, `/dsh stop` and `/dsh rewind` need `allowRun`.** Each one either
causes work, ends work "},{"id":"p28s14","text":"someone at the machine may be watching, or mints an
agent — none of them are reads, and none are ava"},{"id":"p28s15","text":"ilable with `allowRun` off.
- **Attachments are read from Discord's CDN only**, never from a URL in "},{"id":"p28s16","text":"the
message text, and capped at five files. Text files are read as text, 100 KB
each; images go thro"},{"id":"p28s17","text":"ugh the harness's own admission policy — validated,
normalized, and durably stored by `ctx.attachmen"},{"id":"p28s18","text":"ts`, never inlined into the
prompt — and are skipped entirely when no attachment store is composed.
"},{"id":"p28s19","text":"- **Switching preset or permission needs `allowRun`.** Neither runs anything itself, but both decide"},{"id":"p28s20","text":"
what a later turn may do — which tools it is composed with, and whether its commands are sandboxed
"},{"id":"p28s21","text":"or approved — so widening them is gated like execution, not like a read."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer, with `sessionQuery` composed (every profile built on `dsh-base` has it)"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"c.2` or newer, with `sessionQuery` composed (every profile built on `dsh-base` has it)
